materials.title: Learning materials

levelSelect.title: Choose reading level
levelSelect.description: The level defines how many text units will be translated.

20.title: Soft start
20.description: A small number of translated words for an easy start.

40.title: Basic immersion
40.description: A balanced mode with a moderate number of translations.

60.title: Active reading
60.description: More translated units for active reading practice.

80.title: Intensive immersion
80.description: Maximum immersion with many translated words.
